description: This source file implements a program to create a modified 16-bit checksum for Netgear DGN3500 series routers. It includes functions for reading files, calculating checksums with specific adjustments, and appending checksum data to files. It also contains embedded binary data for different PID configurations.

methods.name: readfile
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into memory and returns a pointer to the buffer, along with its size.
